priorityList: Maintain Cat Form and use Prowl before engaging in combat.
Use Tiger's Fury on cooldown, ideally when energy is low or just before activating Berserk or Incarnation.
Cast Ravage (Chomp) whenever the Chomp Enabler buff is active.
Cast Rake while Prowl or Shadowmeld is active; use Shadowmeld in combat to apply an empowered Rake if it is refreshable.
Activate Berserk (or Incarnation: King of the Jungle) while Tiger's Fury is active.
Use Feral Frenzy (or Frantic Frenzy) if you have 2 or fewer Combo Points, or up to 4 during Berserk/Incarnation.
Use Convoke the Spirits while Tiger's Fury or Berserk is active, ideally at low Combo Points immediately after a finisher.
Cast Ferocious Bite for free whenever the Apex Predator's Craving proc is active.
Spend 5 Combo Points (4 during Berserk) on Rip if the bleed is refreshable.
Spend 5 Combo Points (4 during Berserk) on Ferocious Bite. If Berserk is not active, pool enough energy to cast it at 50 energy for maximum damage.
Maintain the Rake bleed on your target, refreshing it if it has less than 4 seconds remaining or if Tiger's Fury is active to increase its damage.
Maintain Moonfire on your target (if talented) and refresh it when it is about to expire.
Use Shred as your primary builder to generate Combo Points when no priority bleeds need refreshing.
Use Regrowth to consume Predatory Swiftness procs if healing is required or the variable is enabled.
